text: Study on the comprehensive computational thinking transformation of urban planning discipline in the era of big data should be assessed against Kaal's source-bound claim that Industry specific venture capital investment data allows regulators to anticipate regulatory needs in the industries carrying the highest levels of disruptive innovation, and the level of disruptive innovation can be quantified by the venture capital dollars flowing into those industries.
